instruction: Use the WinRM communicator in Vagrant (Windows guest)
Set WinRM transport to SSL
Use the WinRM retry limit
Use Vagrant Docker provider (runs a Docker container)
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "docker" do |d| d.image = "nginx:latest" d.ports = ["80:80"] end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Set the Docker provider to keep container running
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "docker" do |d| d.remains_running = true end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Use Docker provider with a command
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "docker" do |d| d.cmd = ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"] end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Use Docker provider with a custom Dockerfile
Use Docker provider with host volumes
Use Docker provider with environment variables
Set Docker provider to force host networking
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "docker" do |d| d.force_host_vm = true end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Use the Parallels provider in Vagrant
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "parallels" do |pl| pl.memory = 2048 pl.cpus = 2 end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Enable Parallells provider linked clones
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "parallels" do |pl| pl.linked_clone = true end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Use Vagrant box from a private registry
Authenticate to Vagrant Cloud / Atlas
Publish a box to Vagrant Cloud
output: vagrant cloud publish myorg/my-box 1.0 virtualbox my-box.box

instruction: Publish a box with a description
output: vagrant cloud publish --description "Ubuntu 22.04 custom box" myorg/my-box 1.0 virtualbox my-box.box

instruction: List Vagrant Cloud boxes for your org
Show details of a Vagrant Cloud box
Revoke a Vagrant Cloud box version
Delete a Vagrant Cloud box entirely
Create a new Vagrant Cloud box version
output: vagrant cloud version create myorg/my-box 1.1 virtualbox

instruction: Add a provider to a Vagrant Cloud version
output: vagrant cloud provider create myorg/my-box 1.1 virtualbox my-box-1.1.box
